commit.message:
fix(verify): the rapid law reads the stock's top under the rapid, not its highest point

Law (d) caps every column at the stock's highest point, so on a stepped
"from model" or carried stock a Bore's entry dive to just above the low
part was convicted as if the boss stood there too, and the post was
blocked for a legal program.

verify::acquit_by_stock_top re-reads an upright vertical dive the column
law convicted (column modes only) against the stock and part solids
under the tool: the highest vertex of every facet whose plan comes
within each stack band's disc - the flute at full radius from the tip,
the shank from the flute's top, the holder from the shank's top. It only
removes a conviction, and only where every band ends above that exact
upper bound; non-finite input, no judged stock, or a flute disc meeting
no facet leaves it standing. Wired at the upright and the 3+2 sites
(local facets there), before acquit_by_prior.

Pinned by crates/app/tests/stepped_stock_rapid.rs (part- and
stock-sourced Bore: the dive over the low step passes and posts; the
boss under it, or under the rim only, is convicted and blocks the post)
and sim::verify::stock_top's unit tests.

Fixes #1091

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(verify): the stock-top re-reading proves nothing from an open mesh

PR #1098 review: acquit_by_stock_top's bound ("the material over a plan
point stands under a facet covering it") holds only for a closed
surface. A from-model stock whose boss lost its top facets let a
stock-sourced Bore's rapid to Z 22 into a boss standing to Z 30 post.

Every solid the re-reading reads must now pass
stock_top_shell::closed_shell or the conviction stands: non-empty,
finite, no 3-D degenerate facet, every undirected edge (exact endpoint
match) used by exactly two facets once each way, one edge-connected
shell, positive signed volume. Computed once per solid per operation,
O(F) with an edge hash map.

Pinned by stepped_stock_rapid::an_open_stock_mesh_proves_nothing_and_
the_dive_stays_convicted (part- and stock-sourced Bore; fails with the
gate off) and stock_top unit tests for an open shell, non-manifold and
duplicated edges, degenerate, inside-out, split, empty and non-finite
solids.

Refs #1091

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(verify): the stock-top re-reading reads the widest stack band and the model excess

After merging main (#971, #1064, #957/#993):
- the bands are never narrower than the laws read the stack: the stated
  shank radius (a #957 drawn neck is never wider), and above the shank
  max(holder, shank) - BodyBands' bound there; every raw number is
  checked before the max (f64::max drops a NaN);
- a coarse model's excess (#864/#904) grows every disc and raises every
  top by it, so a dive clearing the meshed material by less than the
  excess stays convicted; a non-finite excess keeps every conviction.
Both sites pass the op's model excess.

Also: rotary_law_tests' Cutter literal gains `neck: None` - main does
not compile its app lib tests since #1064 and #957 merged (#957 added
the field, #1064 the literal).

Pinned by stock_top::tests::a_coarse_models_excess_is_read_up_and_sideways.

Refs #1091

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(verify): never acquit a dive against a from-model stock of unknown chord

Third review of PR #1098: a from-model stock reads its chord only
through its source model (#1056). With the source deleted, a coarse
casting's excess read 0 and the stock-top re-reading cleared a dive the
flat cap refuses, and it posted.

model_fidelity::stock_fidelity_known(setup) - box, cylinder or no stock:
known; from-model: known only while its source model stands (no
ReducedFidelity record = exact) - rides the job, and both re-reading
sites pass no stock when it is false, so every conviction stands.
`// #1056` marks the guard: once #1127 lets a stock carry its own
chord, read that instead.

The fixtures keep the casting in the tree, marked raw stock only
(#1094, SetStockSourceOnly), with the part beside it. Pinned by
stepped_stock_rapid::a_coarse_stock_whose_source_is_gone_is_never_acquitted
(fails with the guard off) and
a_coarse_stock_whose_source_stands_reads_its_excess.

Refs #1091

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(verify): a stock's source counts only when it is provably the model copied

Fourth review of PR #1098: stock_fidelity_known read "the source model
is still in the tree" by name, so an exact model imported under a
deleted coarse casting's name made the coarse copy read as exact and a
dive into it posted.

The named model now counts only when its current local facets are the
stock's own: the same Arc (SetStock's untouched copy) or the same count
with every coordinate equal bit for bit. A gone source, a stranger under
the name, a source re-meshed without its copy or an empty mesh: not
known, every conviction stands. Placement is not compared - the chord is
the mesh's; a moved source carries the same mesh and record, and an
in-place re-import (UpdateModel) trades copy and record together.

Pinned by stepped_stock_rapid::an_exact_model_imported_under_the_old_name_proves_nothing
and the_guard_follows_the_mesh_not_the_name (both fail with a name-only
guard).

Refs #1091
